propositions: Advanced command grammars across bridge, reconciler, audit, LLM, workflow, and identity modules mix inline argparse construction with manual dispatch, creating duplication and unsafe help behaviors

Parser factories must be extracted into reusable S2a side-effect-free contracts that construct grammars without importing optional runtimes (Pydantic AI, FastAPI, Jira transport, workflow executor, tracing)
Parse failures must transition from raising SystemExit(2) to raising ParseError while preserving identical stderr/usage bytes and exit code semantics in production paths
The S2a factory contract must be extended to support optional presentation keywords (usage, add_help, formatter_class) for commands with bespoke help behaviors while defaulting to RebarHelpFormatter
All advanced routes must register valid parser-factory references and be deterministically generation-ready without handler execution or heavy optional module imports
Production-path tests must verify parse-failure parity, nested selection, exit codes, and byte-identical help output for commands carrying custom usage, formatter, or add_help settings
